Adapted from RapidAI/RapidLaTeXOCR 0.0.9 (MIT license in LICENSE). Source: https://github.com/RapidAI/RapidLaTeXOCR . Local changes: explicit local-only model paths; no downloader; bounded CPU threads; deterministic decoding with time and RAM checks; Python 3.13 / NumPy 2 tested independently. The upstream package itself is not installed because its metadata excludes this environment.
